Ava: quick async — where are we on console observability milestones? specifically retention cutover for traces and the dashboard error-analysis view. Need clear owners and any blockers for the Thu milestone.
Diego: I own trace retention work. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/trace-service/pull/789. Blocked on storage schema change from eng-infra. ETA Wed EOD if infra window is green.
Priya: I own the dashboard error-analysis view. PR is merged to feature branch but depends on tracehook landing to attach spans. Will gate behind feature flag. @Diego can you add a schema compatibility note in your PR so we know mappings?
Diego: yep, adding compatibility notes and a migration plan in the PR description. cc @Sam for rollout window.
Sam: eng-infra here — planning rollout Thursday 02:00-04:00 UTC. We will keep the old schema readable for 48h after rollout. Also exposing header `X-RDW-TRACE` for routing as part of the change.
Ava: perfect. For retention policy we also need updated cost impact numbers so finance/PMs can sign off. @Priya can you add a short cost calc to the ticket?
Priya: on it. quick calc: 30d hot / 90d warm, avg ingest ~0.023 TB/day => ~0.7 TB/day total retention growth. Adding details to ticket #458 and link to cost sheet.
InfraBot: Deploy scheduled: `infra-deploy-2026-03-19T02:00Z`. Notifying impacted services: console-api, trace-ingest.
Diego: to avoid dashboard storms adding config snippet to PR:
```
{
  "trace_retention": {
    "hot_days": 30,
    "warm_days": 90,
    "compress": true
  }
}
```
This will let dashboards gradually backfill instead of reindexing all historical traces.
Ava: :thumbsup: Can each owner add a one-liner in the milestone doc about rollback criteria? I’ll compile before the milestone check-in.
Priya: Added rollback: revert feature flag + restore old index mapping. Also pinged SRE for runbook steps.
Sam: SRE looped. I’ll schedule a short war room during the rollout window and post the invite.
Ava: Thanks — closing the loop for now. If blockers surface drop them here. /cc @eng-sre
